layout.footer: This email was sent by DripNepal about your account.
identity.password_reset.subject: Set your DripNepal password
identity.password_reset.intro: Use the link below to set a new password for your DripNepal account.
identity.password_reset.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.password_reset.expiry: The link works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}.
identity.password_reset.ignore: If you didn't expect this email, you can ignore it. Nothing changes until the link is used.
identity.mfa_enrollment.subject: Set up two-step sign-in for DripNepal
identity.mfa_enrollment.intro: Your DripNepal staff account needs an authenticator app before you can open the admin area. Follow the link below and sign in to set one up.
identity.mfa_enrollment.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.mfa_enrollment.expiry: The link expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. After that, ask the platform team for a new one.
identity.mfa_enrollment.ignore: If you didn't expect this email, tell the DripNepal platform team.
identity.email_verification.subject: Confirm your email for DripNepal
identity.email_verification.intro: Thanks for signing up. Confirm your email address to finish setting up your DripNepal account.
identity.email_verification.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.email_verification.expiry: The link works once and expires in {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}}. After that, sign in to get a new one.
identity.email_verification.ignore: If you didn't create a DripNepal account, you can ignore this email. The account stays unconfirmed until the link is used.
identity.account_exists.subject: Someone tried to sign up with your email
identity.account_exists.intro: Someone, maybe you, tried to create a DripNepal account with this email address. You already have an account, so no new one was created.
identity.account_exists.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.account_exists.forgot: If you forgot your password, choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page to set a new one.
identity.account_exists.ignore: If you didn't try to sign up, you can ignore this email. Your account has not changed.
identity.password_changed.subject: Your DripNepal password was changed
identity.password_changed.intro: The password of your DripNepal account was just changed.
identity.password_changed.sessions: Devices that were signed in with the old password are signed out. If you changed it while signed in, that device stays signed in.
identity.password_changed.yours: If you made this change, there is nothing more to do.
identity.password_changed.not_yours: If you didn't change your password, set a new one now with the link below, and check that nobody else can read your email.
identity.password_changed.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.sessions_revoked.subject: Your DripNepal account was signed out on your devices
identity.sessions_revoked.intro: The devices signed in to your DripNepal account were just signed out.
identity.sessions_revoked.why: This happens when someone chooses "Sign out of all devices" while signed in, and that device stays signed in. It also happens after too many wrong passwords while signed in, and then every device is signed out.
identity.sessions_revoked.yours: If that was you, there is nothing more to do: sign in again on your other devices.
identity.sessions_revoked.not_yours: If you didn't do this, someone may know your password or have a signed-in device. Set a new password now with the link below; that signs out every device.
identity.sessions_revoked.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.mfa_enabled.subject: Two-step verification is on for your DripNepal account
identity.mfa_enabled.intro: Two-step verification was just turned on for your DripNepal staff account. From now on, signing in to the admin area asks for a code from your authenticator app.
identity.mfa_enabled.yours: If that was you, there is nothing more to do.
identity.mfa_enabled.not_yours: If you didn't do this, someone may know your password. Set a new password now with the link below, and tell the DripNepal platform team.
identity.mfa_enabled.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
identity.deletion_requested.subject: We received your request to delete your DripNepal account
identity.deletion_requested.intro: We received a request to delete your DripNepal account.
identity.deletion_requested.closed: Your account is now closed: every device was signed out, and the account can no longer be used to sign in.
identity.deletion_requested.next: DripNepal staff will check the request and then delete the personal details of your account. Order and payment records are kept for as long as business records must be kept.
identity.deletion_requested.not_yours: If you didn't ask for this, or you want to keep your account, contact DripNepal support as soon as you can. Staff can reopen the account until your details are deleted.
identity.deletion_requested.link_hint: If the button doesn't work, copy this link into your browser:
